parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name.

The device name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:). The name must be 4 to 32 characters in length.

The device name must be unique within the product.

parameters.name: DeviceSecret
parameters.description:
The device secret.

The device secret can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:). The secret must be 1 to 32 characters in length.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: Nickname
parameters.description:
The alias of the device.

The alias can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_). The alias must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system does not generate an alias for the device.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the cloud gateway product to which the device belongs.

parameters.name: Sn
parameters.description:
The serial number of the device.

The serial number can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_). The serial number must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system does not generate a serial number for the device.
